items.headline: John Deere hiring 400 workers, recalling 275 more at Iowa, Midwest facilities
items.summary: With the latest recalls, all employees previously laid off in the Quad Cities, Waterloo, Ottumwa and Dubuque have been asked to return to work, Deere said.

items.headline: Tourism brings $1.35 billion to Quad Cities economy despite decline in visits
items.summary: The latest figures from Visit Quad Cities show that in FY 2026, 5.7 million visitors came to the region, resulting in $53 million in direct economic impact.

items.headline: Davenport holding special election for 2nd Ward council seat
items.summary: City Council appointed Bob Inghram to serve as 2nd Ward alderman. However, the city has received a qualifying petition requesting a special election.

items.headline: 2 sentenced in southern Illinois massage prostitution ring
items.summary: The defendants each received 24-month sentences for their role in operating illicit massage businesses in southern Illinois and Indiana.

items.headline: Illinois families save $11.4 million during back-to-school sales tax holiday
items.summary: The results outpaced the $10 million the state estimated consumers would save. It was the first such tax holiday in Illinois since 2022.
